title: Gravity
description:
[h2]Let the map fall[/h2]
Encounters tumble into a compact pile around the starting Ancient. No paths, no climbing the map.

Visit the Ancient first, choose any 15 unvisited encounters in any order, then face the boss. The pile stays put when you reopen the map or reload your run. Double-boss acts keep their second boss.

Gravity changes gameplay. Start a fresh run with it enabled; all co-op players need the mod. Map travel and route overlay mods may conflict.
